name: degoog-web-loader
description: Open WebUI external web loader plugin for degoog.
author: m.porskamp

plugins.name: Degoog Web Loader
plugins.description: Exposes an HTTP endpoint that Open WebUI can use as an external web loader. Fetches pages through any installed degoog transport (4play, curl, flaresolverr, etc.) or plain HTTP fetch. Transport is selected per request.
